products.notes: Electret condenser omni, 600 ohm, frequency response 15 Hz-20 kHz, phantom +15 to +48 V, gold XLR. Spec sheet (v1.2, 2000) lists sensitivity '-60 dB' with no reference (if re 1 V/Pa that is ~1 mV/Pa - very low output, needs high preamp gain), so sensitivityMvPa omitted. No factory calibration file; uncalibrated - third-party calibration (e.g. Cross-Spectrum Labs) or a reference mic needed. Has a noticeable HF rise above ~8-10 kHz uncalibrated. NOTE: no product named 'UCM8000' could be found from any manufacturer/retailer; it is almost certainly ECM8000 (XLR) or ECM8000-U (USB) or an unbranded clone of the ECM8000. Spec sheet: https://lclark.edu/live/files/14600-behringer-ecm8000-manual

USB version: 6 mm omni electret, 20 Hz-20 kHz, deviation <2 dB, direct USB (no interface/phantom). Retailers (Sweetwater) cite 24-bit/48 kHz. Sold as 'calibrated' by some retailers; cal-file source/URL not confirmed from manufacturer page, so calFileAvailable omitted.
